name: Dorei Hisho no Shima
source:
Main character is approached by a mysterious person who offers instructor's job with very generous payment. The job contents is to train completely new type of secretary suitable for the company in the 21st century. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名神秘人物找到主人公，提出一份报酬极其丰厚的教官工作。任务内容是调教一种全新类型的秘书，使其符合21世纪企业的需要。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vndb-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
